title: A look at Roblox's biometric age-checking tool, which will help place its users into age-based accounts starting in June, amid controversy over user privacy (NBC News)
summary: NBC News: A look at Roblox's biometric age-checking tool, which will help place its users into age-based accounts starting in June, amid controversy over user privacy — “Not everyone is going to be happy all the time,” the platform's head of safety product policy told NBC News …
